findings.description: Range on a 0-byte file is answered 416 with Content-Range: bytes */0 and Content-Length: 0 on every shape, so the suspected -1 length never reaches the client; the size?size-1:0 clamp is hidden by the 416 path. No framing break.
findings.title: An empty-file Range computes end=0 while length stays 0, so the 206 header set is planned for a body that cannot exist

limitations: Static build: no upstream, so nothing executes code
Range/416 framing was the interesting axis and is reported for what it showed
